title: How Tesla's Optimus learns from people
title_candidates: How Tesla's Optimus robot is already doing real factory work
Elon Musk's humanoid robot is already working inside Tesla's own factories
Tesla built a robot that learns new tasks by watching people do them
Watch Optimus pick up and sort things no robot could do this well before
The reason Tesla's Optimus moves like a person instead of a machine
caption:
Tesla's Optimus robot is already sorting parts and folding clothes inside Tesla's own factories.

What makes it different from older robots is how it learns. Instead of being manually programmed for each task, it watches humans doing things and copies the motion. The same AI that runs Tesla cars is what drives Optimus.

Tesla's plan is to run thousands of these inside their own factories first, before selling them to anyone outside the company.
